name: ScopeForge Node TLS Safety
summary: Detects a static Node.js TLS verification override in Docker build configuration.

rules.title: Node TLS certificate verification disabled
rules.summary: A Dockerfile disables Node.js TLS certificate verification.
rules.description: Disabling Node.js TLS certificate verification removes server certificate authenticity checks.

explanations.plain: The application is configured to trust unverified encrypted connections.
explanations.developer: Remove NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 and install the required trusted certificate authority instead.
explanations.security: The override disables certificate-chain verification for Node.js TLS clients in the resulting environment.

remediation.guidance: Remove the override and configure the correct CA trust bundle.
remediation.verification: Rebuild and rescan; confirm the override is absent and TLS requests validate the intended certificate chain.

preparedness: Check whether the image was used with sensitive credentials.
falsePositiveNotes: A fixture explicitly marked test-only is excluded by the reviewed path boundary.
